description: Erreygers/Wagstaff-style concentration indices (rineq::ci(), type='CIw') quantifying how each indicator is distributed across the DHS continuous wealth score (v191). Negative = outcome concentrated among the poor; positive = concentrated among the wealthy. Complementary to the 3-category (Low/Middle/High) wealth breakdown surfaced on the Regional Analysis page -- it answers the same 'does this vary by wealth' question using the full wealth continuum rather than discrete bins.

provenance.extracted_by: reading the rendered PDF's concentration-curve figures directly (Figures 4, 7, 10) -- the underlying .qmd's inline prose stats did not evaluate due to a missing `r` engine prefix, but the code-chunk-generated plots, including their annotated values, rendered correctly
provenance.note: The source commit's git tree is not reachable via a normal `git checkout` of task2-regional-indicators -- the file exists as a git blob but the branch tip's recorded tree does not include it (likely a broken commit from a GUI tool). Recovered via `git cat-file -p <blob-sha>`.
provenance.sample_note: Computed on a 12-35 month age band (harmonized across all three indicators), matching the team's app-wide standardization (see docs/methodology.md); the repo's legacy 6-59 month county stunting CSV is kept separately for the v1 intervention ranking's internal consistency (NATIONAL_STUNTING_PCT_6_59_LEGACY in app/utils.py).

indicators.interpretation: Stunting is concentrated among poorer children -- a poorer child is meaningfully more likely to be stunted than a wealthier one.
Full immunisation is concentrated among wealthier children -- a poorer child is meaningfully less likely to be fully vaccinated. A smaller gap than stunting's, but the same direction of inequality.
indicators.sign_flip_note: Recovered source reported this as non_full_immunisation (CI -0.16, 95% CI -0.19 to -0.12). Restated here in the positive-coverage direction (full_immunisation) by negating the index and swapping/negating the CI bounds -- exact for a binary indicator only when its prevalence is close to 50% (full immunisation = 50.3% nationally here), which holds to the precision reported (2 d.p.).

indicators.interpretation: Skilled birth attendance is heavily concentrated among wealthier households -- the largest wealth gap of the three indicators, and the strongest single equity finding in this analysis so far.
